Harm types: the lending example is an allocation in which an apparently neutral criterion disadvantages the family (Indirect_Discrimination); the agency example makes the dominant client group the default and overlooks marginalised groups (Exclusionary_Norms). Mitigation is recommended only: advocacy for more inclusive data (Pre_Processing) and human review, appeals, community forums, training and governance (Organisational_Process). Tasks are named as AI uses in practice: summarising case histories and drafting reports, risk and needs identification, chatbots and drafting client communication, scheduling and data entry, research uses of LLMs, classroom use. The AI literacy framework frames competencies, not the treatment of bias, so AN_Theory_Reference is No; 'antiracist and intersectional lenses' appear only as a recommendation in Table 2.
